name: Microgrid storage minimum-reserve restraint
summary: Restrains the assigned dispatch action to preserve its documented stored-energy reserve.
description: Restrains the assigned dispatch action to preserve its documented stored-energy reserve. Storage coordination combines the battery's energy limits with the converter's electrical capability and the microgrid's operating demand. State of charge, allowable power and connection status describe different aspects of availability.

In a microgrid with a battery energy storage system, the controller can request discharge to support a power deficit while the battery management and conversion systems enforce their own operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Stored energy and reserve requirement” at the input and “Energy-reserve restraint” at the output. Reserved energy and power headroom differ.
